BookingConfirmationTemplate.title: Booking Confirmation Template
BookingConfirmationTemplate.description: Branded email template dispatched immediately when a booking is created. Operators customise subject, HTML/plain-text body, logo, accent colour and footer without code access. Body and subject support {{variable}} placeholders rendered at dispatch by the OpenRegister notification engine (ADR-022). Lifecycle draft -> published -> archived controls which version is active (REQ-BET-001/002/003).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Template under preparation; not used for dispatch.

published.label: Published
published.description: Active template; used for new booking-confirmation emails.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Previously published; no longer dispatched. Kept for audit and history.

publish.label: Publish template
publish.description: Operator (role: communications-manager) activates the template; sets activatedAt to the current timestamp (REQ-BET-002).

archive.label: Archive template
archive.description: Operator retires the template; new emails are no longer dispatched with it (REQ-BET-003). Existing instances remain visible in history.

archiveDraft.label: Archive draft
archiveDraft.description: Operator discards a draft that was never published; kept for history without ever activating.

onPublish.description: Stamp activatedAt with the publication timestamp so the first activation is auditable (REQ-BET-002).

communications-manager.description: Full access: create, edit drafts, publish and archive booking-confirmation templates (booking:template:* per REQ-BET, Task 22).

operator.description: Read-only access for staff who dispatch bookings but do not edit templates (booking:template:list).

auditor.description: Read-only access for audit and compliance inspection.

activatedAt.description: First-publication timestamp. Set once on the publish transition; preserved on later edits (REQ-BET-002).

renderedSubject.description: Subject line with {{variableName}} placeholders replaced from the supplied variable map. Undefined variables render as an empty string (REQ-BET-004).

renderedHtmlBody.description: HTML body with {{variableName}} placeholders replaced from the supplied variable map. Variable values are HTML-escaped to prevent injection (REQ-BET-004, Task 25).

renderedPlainTextBody.description: Plain-text fallback body with {{variableName}} placeholders replaced. Displayed when the client cannot render HTML (REQ-BET-006).

subjectLineLength.description: Character count of the raw subject line. Validated against the 78-character cross-client limit (NFR-BET-002, Task 12).

bodySizeBytes.description: Combined HTML + plain-text body size in bytes. Validated against the 102 KB (104448 bytes) SMTP limit (NFR-BET-003, Task 13).

name.description: Human-readable template name shown in the admin list.
name.title: Name

subjectLine.description: Email subject. Supports {{variable}} placeholders. Limited to 78 characters after substitution for cross-client compatibility (NFR-BET-002).
subjectLine.title: Subject Line

htmlBody.description: HTML email body. Inline styles only, no external CSS or JavaScript. Supports {{variable}} placeholders (NFR-BET-001).
htmlBody.title: Html Body

plainTextBody.description: Plain-text fallback body for clients without HTML rendering. Supports {{variable}} placeholders (REQ-BET-006).
plainTextBody.title: Plain Text Body

logoUri.description: URL to the organization logo image. Loaded from a CDN or document store; inline base64 is not used (NFR-BET-004).
logoUri.title: Logo URI

accentColor.description: Hex colour code for branding accents (e.g. button and header colour).
accentColor.title: Accent Color

footerText.description: Custom footer text (address, contact, legal notice).
footerText.title: Footer Text

senderName.description: Display name shown as the email sender.
senderName.title: Sender Name

senderAddress.description: From-address used for dispatch. Validated by the notification engine against the configured provider (ADR-022).
senderAddress.title: Sender Address

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag the template is authored in. Used to select the template for a customer's language preference (NFR-BET-005).
locale.title: Locale

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the template was first published. Set on the publish transition (REQ-BET-002).
activatedAt.title: Activated At

administrationId.description: Tenant administration this template belongs to. Null for shipped defaults that apply to all administrations.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

BookingReminderTemplate.title: Booking Reminder Template
BookingReminderTemplate.description: Branded reminder email dispatched N hours before a booking starts. The hoursBeforeBooking field configures the reminder timing; the booking system queues dispatch at that offset (REQ-BET-005). Subject/body support {{variable}} placeholders including {{hoursUntilBooking}}. Lifecycle draft -> published -> archived controls the active version.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Template under preparation; not used for dispatch.

published.label: Published
published.description: Active template; reminders dispatched at the configured offset before booking start.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Previously published; no longer dispatched. Kept for audit and history.

publish.label: Publish template
publish.description: Operator activates the reminder template; sets activatedAt (REQ-BET-002).

archive.label: Archive template
archive.description: Operator retires the template; new reminders no longer use it (REQ-BET-003).

archiveDraft.label: Archive draft
archiveDraft.description: Operator discards a never-published draft; kept for history.

onPublish.description: Stamp activatedAt with the publication timestamp (REQ-BET-002).

auditor.description: Read-only access for audit and compliance inspection.

renderedHtmlBody.description: HTML body with placeholders substituted; values HTML-escaped (REQ-BET-004).

subjectLineLength.description: Subject character count, validated against the 78-character limit (NFR-BET-002).

bodySizeBytes.description: Combined body size validated against the 102 KB limit (NFR-BET-003).

hoursBeforeBooking.description: Number of hours before booking start at which the reminder is dispatched (e.g. 24, 2, 1). Configures timing per REQ-BET-005.
hoursBeforeBooking.title: Hours Before Booking

htmlBody.description: HTML email body, inline styles only (NFR-BET-001).
htmlBody.title: Html Body

plainTextBody.example: Hallo {{customerName}}, over {{hoursUntilBooking}} uur start uw boeking.
plainTextBody.title: Plain Text Body

BookingCancellationTemplate.title: Booking Cancellation Template
BookingCancellationTemplate.description: Branded email dispatched when a booking is cancelled. When cancellationReasonRequired is true the {{cancellationReason}} variable is included in the available bindings (REQ-BET-009). Subject/body support {{variable}} placeholders. Lifecycle draft -> published -> archived controls the active version.
